content.rendered:
Hello SMS families!

Leadership is requesting photos for Veterans Day Breakfast. These photos will be shown in the Veterans Day Breakfast slideshow displayed during the event. We are accepting all photos related to veterans day, such as family photos, veterans in uniform, etc.  Please use the form below to upload your photos.
